domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll system shall verify, before each pay run is released, that the stored salary and deduction records match their recorded checksums and shall reject the run if any record differs.
The smart-home controller must verify a cryptographic hash of every automation rule set before applying it and must discard any rule set whose hash does not match.
The web browser shall compare each downloaded file against the digest published by its origin and shall flag the file as corrupted or altered when the values differ.

The database server shall require each new administrative account request to include a unique login name and a credential, and shall verify the requester's identity against the organisation's directory before the account is created.

The smart-home controller must require a new household member to present a unique identifier and a pairing credential, and must confirm that the person is an invited resident before enrolling the member's account.

The screen capture tool shall let a user register a recovery email address and shall only allow the account to be regained after the user proves control of that address through a single-use confirmation link.
The smart-home controller must send a time-limited identity confirmation message to the owner's registered contact address before permitting the owner's access credential to be replaced.

The screen capture tool shall check that every recording's metadata fields, such as duration and resolution, are within valid ranges and shall refuse to store entries that duplicate an existing recording identifier.
The web browser must validate the format and consistency of bookmark entries before saving them and must not store an entry that duplicates an existing one.
The online banking application shall validate the format and checksum of a beneficiary account number before saving it and shall reject any entry that is malformed or already registered.

The compiler shall prevent concurrent build processes from corrupting the shared incremental compilation cache by applying each update atomically and rejecting cache entries whose content hash is inconsistent.
The electronic purse must keep its balance record consistent across simultaneous terminal transactions and must allow only authorised terminals to change that balance.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll system shall ensure that simultaneous edits to an employee's record from different workstations never leave the record partially updated, and shall permit modification only by users holding an edit role.
The sales forecasting system shall reject any uploaded sales figure whose value is not a valid number and shall leave the existing dataset unchanged.
The database server must refuse to write a value into a column when the value does not conform to the column's declared type, and must keep the stored row unmodified.
The air traffic control software shall reject flight plan entries in which altitude, speed or coordinate fields contain values outside their defined types and ranges.
The smart-home controller shall periodically verify its stored device configuration against signed reference values and shall restore any entry found to differ from them.
The compiler must verify the checksums of its standard library and toolchain components at start-up and must refuse to compile if any component has been modified.
The web browser shall validate the signature of its installed extensions and settings store at each launch and shall block any item that has been altered without authorisation.
The online booking system must query the customer account store during sign-in and shall grant access only when the supplied identity matches a registered customer.
The sales forecasting system shall verify each analyst's supplied credentials against the registered user records before opening any forecasting workspace.
The screen capture tool shall require users to prove their identity with their assigned account name and secret before opening its management console.
The compiler's remote build service must authenticate each client with a valid certificate before accepting any compilation job.

The hospital patient-record system shall deploy a decoy server that imitates the records database, capturing and analysing traffic from intruders so that attacks on the real system can be detected and blocked.
The sales forecasting system must expose a fake reporting endpoint that appears to be a live service and must raise an alert and block the source address when any client interacts with it.
The simulation software shall embed an imperceptible mark in every exported result file so that any unauthorised alteration of the file can be detected.
The online banking application must embed a hidden tamper-evident mark in each generated account statement so that any modification of the statement can be detected.
The compiler shall embed a concealed integrity mark in every produced binary so that any later modification of the binary can be detected.
The electronic purse must keep the integrity mark in its transaction records detectable after the records are copied, compressed or deliberately edited in an attempt to erase the mark.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll system shall ensure that the tamper-detection marking in exported payslips remains verifiable after format conversion or deliberate attempts to strip it out.

The hospital patient-record system must ensure that the integrity marking in medical images survives resizing and compression, and survives deliberate attempts to remove it, so alterations remain detectable.
